pages.text: Split pale stumps hold a narrow amber seam. Roots spread from the wood, but the cut does not close. The compass answers these witness stumps: the checkpoints named in a charter.
pages.title: Settled marks
Settle the mark
pages.text: Use them in compass order. The first seals the party. Make room before touching one. Its answer can draw company.

pages.title: An unfinished route
pages.text: Death removes a member; losing the last member ends the expedition.

pages.title: An unfinished route
pages.text: Disconnecting leaves the route for recovery if its landmarks still exist. The last stump is not a way home. Follow the new compass bearing to the hollow tree.
